plan.major: Health Science: Concentration in Exercise Science
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Health Science: Concentration in Exercise Science (BS) program page (poid=1021). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the program requirement as printed on the program page; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. Courses titled 'with Lab' carry separate 0-Hour(s) lab corequisites in the catalog, disclosed in these notes and not placed as separate courses. Catalog anomaly, transcribed as printed and not corrected: CHEM 120's detail page prints its prerequisite as 'XXX 111', a course that does not exist in this catalog, so CHEM 120 carries no recorded prerequisite; the same 'XXX 111' string appears in the printed prerequisites of HSCI 200, HSCI 290 and HSCI 370. The catalog prints no overall program total. The recorded total (72) is the exact sum of the three printed blocks at their exercised values: Science, Mathematics & Data Interpretation Core 35 (the printed range is 34-35; fixed 31 + statistics slot at 4) + Exercise Science Concentration 24 (the block's printed total, itemized exactly; the BS concentration does not include PUBH 320, unlike the BA concentration, as printed) + Experiential Learning & Professional Development 13 (the block's printed total; EXER 270 is printed at 1-4 Hour(s) and is recorded at 3, the value at which the block sums to 13). The core's biology requirement is printed as 'BIOL 065 Human Biology with Lab OR BIOL 101 Biodiversity with Lab' and is recorded as a choice slot at 4 (both options are 4 Hour(s)). EXER 310's and EXER 320's printed prerequisites (BIOL 218 and BIOL 219, MATH 060 or higher) are disclosed here, not recorded, because this plan carries MATH 100 rather than MATH 060. PUBH 300's printed prerequisite (PUBH 250 and one statistics course) names a course outside this program and the statistics choice slot, and is disclosed here, not recorded. BIOL 218's printed prerequisite (BIOL 100 and one of BIOL 101 / BIOL 065 / HSCI 050) is recorded as BIOL 100 only, because the second element depends on the biology choice slot; disclosed here. The catalog's printed lab corequisites in this plan are BIOL 065L or BIOL 101L (per the biology choice), BIOL 100L, BIOL 205L (when BIOL 205 is the statistics choice), BIOL 218L, BIOL 219L, CHEM 110L, CHEM 120L, PHYS 210L and EXER 310L, each 0 Hour(s). No residency note is printed for this program.

courses.title: Cell and Molecular Biology with Lab
Human Biology / Biodiversity
courses.choice_note: Choose one course as printed in the core: BIOL 065 Human Biology with Lab OR BIOL 101 Biodiversity with Lab. Both options are printed at 4 Hour(s), in the catalog's printed order. BIOL 101's detail page prints a prerequisite of BIOL 100 or BIOL 010, disclosed here, not recorded on the slot.

courses.title: Statistics
courses.choice_note: Choose one course for the Statistics block. Options listed at the slot's exercised 4 credits, in the catalog's printed order. The remaining catalog option, PSYC 201 Statistics with SPSS, is printed at 3 Hour(s) and is disclosed here, not listed as a fixed option; a completion using it totals 1 hour less than the recorded total. The BS concentration list does not include INTG 115, as printed.

courses.title: Anatomy and Physiology I with Lab
Anatomy and Physiology II with Lab
Internship Sport and Exer Sci
courses.choice_note: Required in the Experiential Learning & Professional Development block. Printed at 1-4 Hour(s) on its detail page and recorded here at 3, the value at which the block sums to its printed 13 hours; at 1 hour the block totals 11 and at 4 hours it totals 14, as printed. Its printed prerequisite (2.0 GPA and EXER 310 or EXER 320) is disclosed here, not recorded, per the choice-slot / variable-course precedent; EXER 310 and EXER 320 are both in this plan. Title truncated as printed ('Sci' / 'Exer Sci' abbreviations as printed).
